extraction.method: Values were taken from the published figures (300 ppi images in the article PDF). Axes were calibrated by a straight-line fit to the detected tick marks; a marker centre is the centroid of its colour-segmented blob (for a triangle, the centre of its bounding box, where the plotting program places the value), or, for a marker partly hidden by another, the centre implied by its visible edge and the marker size; a curve is a least-squares parabola through column-wise centroids.
extraction.uncertainty: Each stated uncertainty is 2.5 pixels on the figure axis, taken as one standard uncertainty. It is an extraction uncertainty, not a statistical uncertainty of the simulation.
extraction.checks: The horizontal marker positions return the four tube diameters within 0.005 nm. The (6,6) point of Fig. 7a, for which Eq. 5 gives +0.00005 pL/s, reads +0.00004 pL/s.

unresolved: Tube length: 6.4 nm in the text (pp. 19076–19077), 6 nm in Fig. 1. The benchmark uses 6.4 nm, which is 26 armchair unit cells; with 6 nm the parabolic part of the model is 6.7 % larger.
Slip velocity at the wall position: 3.89 ± 0.15 m/s from Fig. 5a (marker partly hidden); the published curve of Fig. 6a ends at 4.05 m/s.

The published profile curves (Fig. 6a) have the curvature of the interfacial viscosity; the published flow rate of Fig. 7a uses the experimental viscosity. The benchmark uses one viscosity for both outputs.
Fig. 4a shows a different molecular-dynamics profile for the same tube (nine points, 5.9 to 4.0 m/s). The benchmark uses the six points of Fig. 6a, which agree with the published flow rate.
Fig. 9b plots Eq. 5 with D, the slip velocity and the interfacial viscosity at 0.0244 pL/s; Fig. 7c plots the same combination at 0.0266 pL/s. The published inputs return the Fig. 7c value.
Flow definition: the paper converts the molecule count with a molecular volume V_water that it does not state.
Slip-length forms (Eqs. 4, 6 and 7) are not enabled for this case: the slip-length marker at D is hidden in Fig. 5b and the end-loss coefficient c of Eq. 7 is not stated.
